cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned the frames to the wall like you. Ready for the last gallery. Keep painting; I'll pack them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking the hanging wire. Did the big gallery reject me too? If they did, I'm done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Secure the backs, then. Their letter can wait; this gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

reason: Remove yes that could disclose rejection before the concealment tactic; retain confident practical cover and hopeful redirection.
